items.t: Transmission stops engaging Drive or Reverse
items.note: Owners report about $1,500 to $3,300; CarComplaints lists about $2,200 on average.

items.t: Broken front coil spring can cut a tire (recall)
items.job: Install spring shield or replace front coil springs
items.note: Free if the recall work was never done. If the recall is closed, a pair of front struts with springs runs roughly $300 to $600 in parts.

items.t: Rear coil spring breaks
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $1,140 to $1,500 when struts and links were done too.

items.t: Worn struts and strut mounts
items.job: Replace front struts as complete assemblies (pair)
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $600 to $935 for strut work.

items.t: Clunking from sway bar end links
Worn ball joints and tie rod ends
items.job: Replace tie rod ends and ball joint (one side)
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $300 to $800.

items.t: Misfire from a failed ignition coil
items.job: Replace ignition coil (one) and spark plugs
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $175 to $400 for coil work; one 2009 owner paid $870 for all six.

items.t: Clicking behind the dash or temperature stuck
Fuel pump failure
items.note: TrueDelta owners report about $600 to $1,000.

items.t: Alternator stops charging
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $280 to $630.

items.t: Water pump leaks coolant
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $100 to $480.

items.t: Intake manifold gasket leak on the DOHC V6
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $240 to $426.

items.t: Stalling from a leaking PCV hose
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $125 to $234.

items.t: A/C compressor or clutch fails
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $100 for a clutch to $767 for a compressor.

items.t: Rear drum brake wheel cylinder leaks
items.job: Replace rear wheel cylinders and brake shoes

items.t: Clicking when turning from a worn CV axle
items.note: TrueDelta owners report about $1,000 for both axles.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner failure
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner

items.t: Internal water pump leaks coolant into the oil
items.job: Replace internal water pump and timing chain parts
items.note: Many shops replace the timing chain at the same time. Engine damage from coolant in the oil costs far more.

items.t: Power steering assist cuts out
items.note: Owners report about $750 to $1,000.

items.t: Six-speed automatic shifts roughly or hesitates
items.job: Reprogram transmission computer and service fluid
items.note: Internal repairs cost far more.

items.t: Transmission cooler line leak
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $750 to $1,400.

items.t: A/C condenser leaks
items.note: TrueDelta owners report $700 to $820.

items.t: Stalling or rough idle from a dirty idle air valve
Oil pan gasket leak
items.note: TrueDelta owners report about $668 to $763 with other work.

items.t: Car may roll away in Park (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair shift linkage and park system
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Brake and gas pedals set too close (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
items.job: Replace wiper motor cover or motor
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.t: Headlights may be hard to turn on (recall)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.

items.note: Free at a Ford dealer if the recall work was never done.
